name: sandbox
description: A package to test another Allure Report packages in action
author: Qameta Software

scripts.check:passed: yarn allure check --name "Sandbox passing check" --output ./allure-results -- node -e "console.log('The sandbox passing check succeeded')"
scripts.check:failed: yarn allure check --name "Sandbox failing check" --output ./allure-results -- node -e "console.error('The sandbox failing check failed'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.t: yarn pret && yarn allure run -- yarn t:run
scripts.t:run: yarn check:passed && (yarn check:failed || true) && vitest run
scripts.lint: vp lint --import-plugin src test features stories
scripts.lint:fix: vp lint --import-plugin --fix src test features stories
